channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 240-million-year-old reptile fossil reveals pre-dinosaur era
item.description: A 240-million-year-old reptile fossil found in Brazil offers insights into evolution just before dinosaurs and crocodiles appeared.

item.title: Podcast: The Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST)
item.description: NSF Noirlab's Robert Blum discusses the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's LSST mission and its potential to transform our understanding of the universe.

item.title: Rare total solar eclipse to darken Europe; watch live
item.description: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will darken parts of Europe, with Spain offering prime viewing. ESA will provide a live stream.

item.title: Potato cultivation may have boosted Andean digestive adaptation
item.description: The introduction of potatoes in the Andes may have influenced human genetics. Indigenous Peruvians show unusually high numbers of a starch-digesting gene.
